obligations.statement: T must be typed independently of any single mechanism class.
obligations.goal: Ensure that T can represent lattice-based, graph-based, and manifold-based constraints equally.

obligations.statement: Gamma_T must be evaluable from T.
obligations.goal: Define the mapping between the T-object and the boolean Gamma_T check.

obligations.statement: Residue changes may alter T without altering the Primary Axiom.
obligations.goal: Verify the stability of the core logic under topological evolution.
